messages:
anya: Heads-up — I spun up the new vector model aquila-v1 on staging and ran a quick synthetic probe. Int8 quant looks faster but seeing weird cluster collapse around a few anchor points. anyone else seeing this pattern?

mohit: Saw the deploy-bot note, can you paste the eval commands / metrics?

anya: Sure — ran the usual holdout + synthetic anchors. Command I used:```
python -m rf_eval.run --model aquila-v1 --quant int8 --dataset synthetic-anchors --ks 1,5,10 --embed-batch 128
```

ci-bot: deploy-bot: model aquila-v1 (staging) successfully started on pool-gpu-staging-2 :rocket:

sarah: Quick numbers from the run (synthetic anchors): recall@1 0.82, recall@5 0.91, recall@10 0.93. Baseline heron-v2 (float16) is recall@1 0.90. So there's a drop ~8pts at k=1.

eli: That drop at k=1 + cluster collapse sounds like embedding collapse not indexing bug. Did you check L2 norm distribution / mean length?

anya: Good call. Norms look tighter in int8 — mean 0.87 vs 1.01 on float16. std also down. Possibly aggressive per-channel clamping in the quant pipeline.

mohit: Can you run a stratified smaller sample where we keep long vs short queries separate? suspect short queries are getting projected to same bin. Also compare cosine vs dot for nearest neighbor, just in case.

anya: Will run. Also attaching a quick UMAP of the synthetic anchors — looks like two anchor groups merged.

jordan: If it's quant clipping, try per-tensor vs per-channel. We saw similar in ember bringup. Quick experiment: quantize only the feedforward weights (leave norm/scales fp16) — sometimes helps.

anya: Running three jobs now: (1) per-channel int8, (2) per-tensor int8, (3) hybrid (norms fp16). Will collect recall@1,5,10 + silhouette + mean L2.

eli: Add a micro-batch of real short queries too (from short-query set). If short tail fails, that's a blocker for rollout.

ci-bot: bench-bot: queued 3 eval jobs for aquila-v1 on staging (ids: 4823,4824,4825)

anya: Quick result from job 4823 (per-channel int8): recall@1=0.80, recall@5=0.90, silhouette=0.21, mean L2=0.78.

mohit: Per-tensor results?

anya: 4824 (per-tensor int8): recall@1=0.87, recall@5=0.92, silhouette=0.33, mean L2=0.95. Much closer to baseline.

jordan: Nice — that points to per-channel scaling mismatch. Any throughput regression?

anya: Throughput ~ +18% vs float16 on staging for per-tensor int8, latency p95 within SLO.

eli: Next steps: (1) reproduce on a larger holdout (not just synthetic anchors), (2) add UMAP+silhouette commits to the onboarding PR, (3) update quant pipeline to try per-tensor defaults for this architecture, (4) add unit test that checks mean L2 shift < 0.1 after quant.

anya: Will open the PR with the eval logs and images. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mohit: Also add a note to the model on-call runbook that aquila-v1 int8 default = per-tensor for now, until we fiddle with calibration.

anya: Added to the runbook checklist in the PR. Link when ready.

sarah: TL;DR: aquila-v1 int8 viable with per-tensor quant; per-channel caused cluster collapse and recall@1 regressions.

eli: Great. If PR shows consistent holdout numbers we can greenlight a small canary.

anya: Will follow up with the PR link shortly.
